entry.title: The ‘Spark of Life’ That Formed Your Inward Parts
entry.summary: Footage of the egg under a microscope is mesmerizing, depicting a perfect sphere. As the grainy video plays, a single sperm makes contact with the egg’s surface, and suddenly a flash of light spreads from the point of contact. The whole surface of the egg is enveloped in light for one instant and then goes dark again.
